title: Contextual Acceptance Loom: quant validation runner with dual-metric gates
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem: We lack an automated, context-aware acceptance runner that can gate FP8/INT8 rollouts using both semantic fidelity and logit-space stability. Current ad-hoc checks surface too many false positives (surface-level token diffs that are benign) and miss subtle distributional drift (logit divergence) that degrades downstream tasks.

Goal: Build a reusable harness — the 'Acceptance Loom' — that stitches augmented golden cohorts (contextual + adversarial perturbations), computes a dual-metric signal (semantic similarity on embeddings + calibrated logit divergence), and evaluates pass/fail using weighted, cohort-aware thresholds. The harness should integrate into CI (GH Actions) and nightly canary pipelines, produce detailed telemetry, and trigger runbooks for triage when gates fail.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Harness runs deterministically in CI with a reproducible seed and produces a human-readable summary + artifact bundle (golden inputs, model outputs, metric traces).
2) Dual-metric gate defined: primary semantic similarity (embedding cosine) with cohort-specific thresholds and a secondary logit-divergence check (KL or JS) with layer-weighted sensitivity.
3) Gate logic: pass if primary metric >= threshold OR (primary >= soft_threshold AND secondary <= stability_threshold).
4) Nightly scheduled run that evaluates latest candidate model artifacts and writes pass/fail to deployment gating dashboard + emits alerts on failure.
5) Failure telemetry includes compare diff visualizations, top contributing prompts, per-layer sensitivity heatmap, and a suggested rollback tag.
6) Documentation + runbook created and reviewed by SRE and MLQA teams.
tech_notes:
Design components: harness-runner (python), golden-manager (curation service), perturbation-engine (synthetic paraphrases + slot swaps), metric-aggregator (embedding similarity via SBERT + cosine, logit divergence via KL on top-k logits), gate-engine (config-driven weighted thresholds).
Calibration: build a calibration job that maps raw semantic scores to calibrated pass probabilities per-cohort using isotonic regression on historical rollouts.
Cohorting: sample by domain, prompt-length, and token-distribution; maintain an anchored seed set and an augmented set for adversarial stress tests.
Rollout policy: integrate with rollout orchestrator to block FP8/INT8 promotions when gate fails; expose manual override with audit log.
Implementation notes: use batch-mode inference with KV cache replay to mimic production latency profiles. Persist artifacts to s3://redwood-quant-golden/loom/{date}/{model}.
CI hooks: GH Actions job 'quant-acceptance-loom' with matrix builds for model variants. Provide a lightweight docker image for reproducibility.
Observability: emit metrics to Cortex/Grafana: loom.run.duration, loom.gate.pass_rate, loom.metric.semantic.mean, loom.metric.logit.kld.mean.
Security: ensure golden inputs do not contain PII; golden-manager verifies sources and tags provenance.
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Initial spike completed. Evaluated candidate semantic metrics (SBERT, SimCSE) and logit divergence estimators. Decided on SBERT-base for speed/accuracy tradeoff.

2026-02-18: Prototype harness implemented that runs against small golden seed. Early results: semantic metric correlates with human judgments (rho=0.72) but misses syntax-preserving failure modes; added logit-KL probe.
2026-02-26: Calibration job sketched. Chose isotonic regression to map raw similarity to pass probabilities; gathered historical rollouts for calibration dataset (runtime-1.18, runtime-1.19 models).
2026-03-03: Trade-off decision: prioritize cohort-specific soft thresholds over a single global threshold to reduce false positives in domain-heavy cohorts. Documented threshold inheritance rules.
2026-03-07: SRE review feedback: require artifact retention for 90 days and signed URLs for download. Added retention and provenance metadata to artifact spec.
2026-03-10: PRD and runbook draft uploaded; requested design review from MLQA (assigned to Priya Rao). Implementing CI job and dashboard panels this sprint.
2026-03-12: Implemented gate-engine prototype and integrated with nightly runner. First end-to-end run completed (passed on seed set; flagged 2 augmented prompts as borderline).
notes_for_reviewers: Please focus review on gate semantics and cohort definitions. Two open questions: (1) Should we use top-k logit distributions (k=32) or full-vocab subsampling for KL computation to balance cost? (2) What retention policy for augmented artifacts is reasonable given storage costs?
runbook_summary: On gate failure: 1) triage alert posted to #quant-gates with artifacts link; 2) run 'loom quick-diff' to generate top 10 contributing prompts; 3) if failure rate > 5% across stable cohort, automatically halt FP8 promotion and create rollback tag; 4) escalate to ML lead + SRE for postmortem.
qa_plan: Automated smoke checks integrated in CI; nightly full-run with deterministic seed; manual review of borderline failures via generated artifact bundle. Include a small human-eval task for top-5 flagged prompts to calibrate thresholds before blocking production rollouts.

golden-manager: implement curator API and provenance tagging
metrics: implement semantic and logit processors
ci: GH Actions job and docker image
observability: Grafana panels and alert rules
